summary.text: Charles Hughes is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a member of the Antelope Valley Union High School District school board, a U.S. Navy veteran, and a farmer and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Hughes served in the U.S. Navy from 1987 to 1990, earned a diploma from Springfield High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Chapman University.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a retired law enforcement lieutenant and small business owner in the Antelope Valley, and a former two-term president of the Antelope Valley Union High School District board.
He serves as a trustee for Trustee Area 1 on that board.

In the survey, Hughes listed his campaign messages as making life affordable by opposing a mileage tax, cutting regulations and delivering middle-class tax relief; supporting law enforcement and ending early release for repeat offenders; and protecting parental rights in education.
